add_item.class_required: Choose at least one class for this subject.

classes.title: Applicable classes
classes.body: Choose the class or classes the question is intended for. Select more than one when the same question suits multiple classes.

subject.title: Subject
subject.body: Choose the subject for the selected class. If you change the subject, choose its chapter and topic again.

chapter.title: Chapter
chapter.body: Choose the chapter in the selected subject's book or syllabus that the question comes from. Leave it blank if the chapter is not known.

topic.title: Topic
topic.body: Choose the specific lesson, concept, or grammar topic within the chapter. Related topics appear after you choose a chapter.

type.title: Question type / exam part
type.body: Choose how the question is answered or which exam part it belongs to. This is separate from its chapter or curriculum location.

difficulty.title: Difficulty
difficulty.body: Rate how challenging the question is from 1 to 5. Use a lower value for easier questions and a higher value for harder ones.

marks.title: Marks
marks.body: Enter the marks assigned to this question in the exam. Decimal values are allowed.

sources.title: Source history
sources.body: Record where the question previously appeared, such as a board, institution, or exam. Enter only known details; source information is optional.
sources.example_bn: ঢাকা বোর্ড · SSC · ২০২৫ · প্রশ্ন ৬ · সেট ক
sources.example_en: Dhaka Board · SSC · 2025 · Question 6 · Set A

curriculum.title: Place in syllabus
curriculum.body: Search and select the curriculum items that match this question. Leave it empty when none apply; select multiple when needed. Use the icon beside an item to see naming examples.
curriculum.example_bn: বাংলা: গদ্য → অপরিচিতা → টপিক; ইংরেজি: Part 1 → Unit 2 → Lesson 3
curriculum.example_en: Bangla: Prose → অপরিচিতা → Topic; English: Part 1 → Unit 2 → Lesson 3

workflow.title: Question submission and publishing
workflow.body: Save the question first. When it is ready, submit it for review. A Content Moderator or Super Admin reviews it and can return it or publish it.
workflow.example_bn: খসড়া সংরক্ষণ → যাচাইয়ে পাঠান → যাচাই → প্রকাশ
workflow.example_en: Save draft → Submit for review → Review → Publish
